evaluation.name: potential-2025-v1 | pine-overnight-block

strategy.name: Pine · Overnight block
strategy.description: Clock-window transition orders evaluated at the bar close, filled at the next open. Default 17:00 arming captures the 18:00 CME reopen.
strategy.migration_scope: Ports the Pine clock/order rules, including boundary-only entries. Scoring starts flat; no entry midway through an existing hold window. Costs and contract economics use the run inputs.

warnings: Continuous volume-rolled prices are unadjusted. Roll gaps can affect signals and P&L; no roll-neutral performance claim.
Gaps include closures and no-trade minutes; an exchange holiday calendar and historical revision timestamps are unavailable.
Acquisition time uses local archive modification time, not a verified vendor download receipt.

evaluation.hypothesis: Fixed selected parameters from run 175b4eb0-942d-4f19-b23d-1c9c2a5b7b69. Evaluate 2025; calibrate states on 2024. No retuning. Descriptive historical potential at tested sizing. Later history, not certified untouched data. Regime attribution does not simulate trading only in a selected state.

result.boundary: Each test fold starts and ends flat; fixed sizing capital; joined dollar P&L with continuous equity peaks. Costs include each fold liquidation. Warmup is excluded from scored P&L.

3 previously successful runs overlap the test interval; prior exposure is preserved in the evaluation record.
